implementation: Pack Manager: Groq vision lists the items in the open box (blind to the order); engine.py matches them to the order: SEAL / STOP & FIX / UNCERTAIN. Needs GROQ_API_KEY.
notes: In-process by default. Serves FastAPI/Uvicorn on port 8103. Uses visual verification of package contents against expected orders to make SEAL or STOP & FIX determinations.
